# Scrim

Film that darkens the screen behind a modal: scrim (#000) at 32 %. Covers the whole screen, under the sheet.

Annotation type: `m3-scrim` (Scrim).

## Size

- Initial: 412 × 917 px
- Minimum: 16 × 16 px
- Sizing: width fill, height fill
